title: Ledgerline
brief: Landing page for Ledgerline, a bookkeeping app for freelancers and tiny agencies in the UK. It connects to your bank, auto-categorises transactions, matches receipts photographed on your phone, tracks VAT and estimates your Self Assessment tax bill in real time, so there are no surprises in January. Exports to accountants in one click. Pricing: a free plan for up to 20 transactions a month, and a paid plan. We're in public beta, so the main goal is getting people onto the waitlist / free signup. Audience: designers, developers, writers and consultants who hate admin. Tone: smart, calm, a little dry humour. The paid plan's price isn't set yet, so show it as a placeholder. No customer logos, user numbers, ratings or testimonials: we have none to show yet. The signup form isn't connected, so don't fake a confirmation.
